scope: 25 US airports; reporting-carrier domestic flight events; experimental airport windows
selection: Choose one learner for all directions/horizons by mean flight-weighted disruption Brier across the three development folds and six slices. Prefer linear unless boosted improves by at least 0.5% relative. Never choose or tune using 2026 outcomes.
calibration: Airport-aware sigmoid with C=0.02 on fixed log odds plus airport indicators; six-month final calibration. No class rebalancing.
interval: Central signed-residual 80% empirical band from nine months; airport plus predicted-risk bins (<25%,25-50%,50%+) with >=100 windows, otherwise airport fallback. No guarantee under temporal dependence.
evidence: Moderate requires sample support, positive 95% Brier-skill interval, BH-adjusted approximate bootstrap p <= 0.1 across 150 airport/direction/horizon comparisons, calibration error <5pp, and band coverage >=75%.
fairHorizonComparison: Common eligible windows at all horizons; publish per-airport and per-horizon missingness as well as primary metrics.
limitations: January-February 2026 was not loaded or evaluated in v1, but evaluates winter only
March-June 2026 has been inspected in v1 and is a disclosed stress re-evaluation, never a new holdout
Candidate development validation overlaps the final probability calibration period; final interval calibration and fresh test remain outside selection
Final-vintage BTS outcomes; no release-vintage reconstruction or cancellation announcement time
TAF issue/product time plus lag approximates historical delivery
No private or global flight-outcome transfer
